name: birthday-field
title: Birthday field
description: A date of birth without a calendar: day, month by name and a typed year, with the age rule checked in words and the right autofill tokens set.
docs: value and onValueChange(iso, { valid }) speak ISO dates (1990-03-14), with an empty string while the date is incomplete, impossible or not allowed; only the date is reported, never an age. The order of the three parts and the names of the months come from locale (en-US by default). minAge and maxAge are whole years, the age rules are checked from today in the reader's own time zone, and today (an ISO date) pins the clock for a server or a test. A date that does not exist (31 February), that is in the future or that breaks an age rule is explained in words, the wrong part is marked red, and the one message under the group is what the group's aria-describedby points at; with a valid date the same line tells a screen reader the date it understood. A day over 31 and a year of one to three digits left behind are noticed at once. messages replaces the words (tooYoung and tooOld are functions of the age), labels renames the small labels and placeholders for another language. The parts carry autocomplete bday-day, bday-month and bday-year; the month is the house select, whose hidden native select is what a browser fills, so keep the field inside a form for autofill. name adds a hidden input with the ISO date, and id goes on the first part, so a label's htmlFor focuses the field; name the group with aria-labelledby.
